name: Cubic
tagline: AI code review for GitHub PRs plus scheduled whole-codebase bug scans, with local CLI review, custom agents, and issue checks.
pricing: Free: 20 PR reviews/mo; Team $30/dev/mo annual ($40 monthly); Pro $79/dev/mo annual ($99 monthly); Enterprise custom. Free for OSS teams
selfHostedNote: No self-hosted or VPC deployment published; Enterprise details gated behind a demo (lists GitHub Enterprise support only).
modelControl: Fixed vendor models (OpenAI, Anthropic); BYOK listed only as an Enterprise plan feature

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: AI wiki indexes the repo; cross-repo reviews can read up to 5 linked repositories during PR review.

02-rule-centric.note: cubic.yaml custom agents with sensitivity levels and ignore filters; docs promise minimal verbosity.

03-dual-workflow.note: Local CLI review before pushing, IDE/agent setup (Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code), and an MCP server.

04-business-logic.note: Checks PRs against linked Linear/Jira issue requirements, posting a done/missing table in the review.

05-continuous-learning.note: Thumbs up/down calibrate per-codebase noise; typed replies are remembered; learnings visible in settings.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No documented code execution, test runs, or preview-environment validation.

07-economic-transparency.note: BYOK gated to Enterprise; per-seat pricing with LOC quotas and flex top-ups; no token-cost visibility.

08-actionability.note: 'Fix with cubic' background agents generate and apply fixes; Pro adds auto-created fix PRs.

09-measurable-roi.note: Review, delivery, and authorship dashboards incl. cycle-time and merge-time trends; no cost-per-PR telemetry.
